title: Create a 15 second, 16:9 realistic viral social media vid...
prompt:
Create a 15 second, 16:9 realistic viral social media video that looks like authentic low resolution smartphone footage, not a polished film or AI generated scene.

0.0–8.6 seconds: A wide, elevated handheld smartphone shot from the top of a steep sandy hill overlooking a quiet natural pond. A long, bright blue plastic tarp has been laid down the entire slope like a homemade water slide, continuing all the way to the edge of the water. A shirtless, heavyset adult man wearing black knee length shorts lies flat on his stomach at the top of the wet tarp, facing downhill. Someone just outside the frame gives him a small push. He rapidly slides belly first down the slippery blue plastic, becoming smaller as he travels farther away. The phone camera remains near the top of the hill and follows him with a slightly shaky downward tilt and a subtle digital zoom. Show pale sand around the tarp, a parked white vehicle and two tiny people near the shoreline, calm grey-blue water, green marsh patches and thin trees in the distance. 

The man reaches the narrow final section of the tarp and shoots directly onto the surface of the pond without sinking. He unexpectedly skims across the water at high speed while still lying forward, producing two strong symmetrical trails of white spray and a long widening V shaped wake behind him. The moment should initially feel impressive, funny and believable, with realistic water physics, ripples and imperfect phone-camera focus.

8.6–9.3 seconds: Just as the man reaches the distant side of the pond, suddenly insert a crude, frightening jump-scare overlay directly in the center of the screen: a grotesque horror clown with messy orange red hair, pale cracked skin, an unnaturally wide mouth, sharp teeth and intensely glowing red eyes lunges rapidly toward the camera. The clown should appear abruptly and fill most of the frame, like an old internet prank video, with rough compositing and compressed visual quality rather than cinematic horror effects.

9.3–10.2 seconds: Hard cut to a separate handheld phone recording inside a small pink bedroom. A young woman with long straight dark hair, large clear eyeglasses and a light-colored floral dress sits casually on a bed, holding a blue smartphone close to her face as though she has just watched the waterslide video. Behind her is a pink decorated wall with hanging medals, small framed pictures, butterfly stickers and decorative writing; a pale curtain hangs on the right, and the room has a simple corrugated metal ceiling. Butterfly-print pillows are visible on the bed.

The jump scare frightens her instantly. Her eyes widen, mouth opens, shoulders jerk upward, both arms fly into the air and the phone slips violently from her hands. She recoils and collapses backward against the pillows in an uncontrolled, genuinely startled reaction. Use strong natural motion blur, slight camera shake and awkward body movement.

10.2–15.0 seconds: Freeze the video on the funniest reaction frame: the woman leaning backward on the bed, mouth open, head tilted, one arm raised and the phone caught mid air beside her. Hold this exact frozen frame until the video ends, preserving the blurry compressed look of a reposted meme clip.

Visual direction: Authentic amateur smartphone recording, ordinary daylight, slightly washed out colors, low bitrate, visible compression, inconsistent autofocus, mild motion blur, imperfect framing and natural handheld shake. Compose the outdoor action through the center of the horizontal 16:9 frame while showing additional pond, shoreline, sand and trees on both sides. Keep all people anatomically consistent before the jump scare. No cinematic grading, no dramatic camera orbit, no slow motion, no smooth drone movement, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no dialogue and no background music.

title: SCENE CONTEXT
prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
In a frozen post-apocalyptic wasteland, an armored snow-truck races down a white highway, fleeing a massive blizzard-avalanche rolling in behind it. Inside the churning wall of snow, the colossal face of an ice monster forms and dissolves. The shot opens on a vast white vista where the truck is a tiny speck, then pushes in one continuous move to the cab, revealing the male driver and a woman in the passenger seat. Grounded, photoreal, high-budget fantasy realism — every surface, particle, and performance reads as captured live, not generated.
LOCATION MAP
Wide frozen plateau. A snow-packed highway cuts diagonally from deep background (upper-left, x 30%, y 38%) toward foreground (lower-right). Flat tundra and dead, ice-crusted utility poles flank the road. Behind the truck, north horizon, a 200-meter-tall wall of churning white blizzard/avalanche advances. Weak sun glow hidden behind the storm wall acts as backlight from screen-rear. Lighting direction: diffuse top-down with cold backlit haze from behind the truck.
FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
First visible frame is a super-wide aerial-height vista. The snow-truck sits deep background, center-frame, x 50%, y 46%, scale tiny (under 4% of frame width), driving toward lower-right and toward camera along the diagonal road. The blizzard wall fills the background behind it, x 0% to 100%, upper half of frame, advancing. No empty plate — the truck is present and moving in frame one. As the camera pushes in, the truck grows to fill frame; by the end the cab and windshield dominate, x 50%, y 50%, large scale, driver (screen-left seat) and woman (screen-right seat) clearly visible through the glass.
Driver: torso faces forward down the road, hands gripping the wheel, eyes flicking to the side mirror toward the storm. Woman: torso forward, head turned back over her shoulder toward the storm wall, then snapping front. Both bodies face direction of travel (screen-lower-right).
FORMAT MODE
Single continuous take. Real-time motion. No cuts. No subtitles, no music.
OPTICS
One continuous push-in shot with a prime-lens optical character — clean, sharp center field, gentle natural falloff, no zoom-breathing, fixed-focal clarity. Begin on a 107° wide rectilinear character: immense environment spread to all frame edges, straight horizon, truck a tiny element in vast space, no fisheye curve. The camera then dollies forward continuously, the lens character settling toward an 84° classic wide as it closes on the cab — strong foreground presence, environment and storm still visible at frame edges, straight lines rectilinear, immersive close perspective on the windshield. One smooth optical move, no hard stop; perspective expands naturally as distance collapses. Prime-lens rendering throughout: crisp micro-contrast, organic shallow falloff on the cab at the end.
CAMERA
ARRI Alexa large-format cinema-camera character — wide tonal latitude, gentle highlight roll-off in the bright snow, clean shadow detail, true filmic color science. Camera starts at high aerial height looking down-forward over the road, far from subject, then descends and pushes in along the road axis, accelerating to match and slightly overtake the truck, ending at windshield height roughly 2 meters off the truck's front-left quarter. Movement is a powerful, weighted aerial-to-chase glide — fast forward velocity, slight motion-settle as it locks onto the cab, subtle real operator weight, no random jitter, no drone float. Focus rides the truck throughout; background storm stays slightly soft, truck razor-sharp by the end.
ACTION TIMING
0.0s to 2.0s: Super-wide vista, tiny truck speeding down the diagonal road, blizzard wall looming and advancing, snow streaming off the road surface.
2.0s to 5.0s: Continuous push-in, truck grows, snow tracks throwing white spray, exhaust steam ripping off the stacks, the ice monster's face surfacing in the storm wall behind.
5.0s to 8.0s: Camera locks onto the front-left quarter and cab; through the windshield the driver grips the wheel and checks the mirror, the woman turns from looking back at the storm to facing forward, both tense, the truck roaring past camera-near.
PERFORMANCE (Hollywood-grade acting)
Naturalistic, restrained, high-stakes performances captured like seasoned A-list film actors. The driver's fear reads through micro-expression, not theatrics: tight jaw, a hard swallow, eyes darting between the road and the mirror, white-knuckle grip, controlled breathing. The woman plays escalating dread — a sharp glance back at the monster, pupils widening, a flinch, then forcing composure as she snaps front and braces a hand on the dash. Real eye-line continuity, genuine weight behind every reaction, no stiff or doll-like faces, no exaggerated mugging. Believable adrenaline and chemistry between two survivors who have done this before.
PHYSICS
Vehicle: heavy armored mass on massive studded rear snow-tracks and oversized spiked balloon front tires, a steel snowplow blade angled at the nose. Throws continuous white snow-spray and powder rooster-tails from the tracks; suspension compresses over road ridges, body rocks with inertia, exhaust stacks vent hot steam shearing backward in the wind. Snow particles travel in correct depth planes and accumulate on hood and cab roof.
Storm: blizzard wall churns with turbulent rolling motion, snow and ice particles driven forward by wind, denser at the base. The monster face forms from compacted swirling snow — jagged ice teeth, hollow pale-glowing eye-sockets, frost-crystal features — coalescing and partly dissolving, never fully solid, made of moving snow and ice shards.
Bodies: driver's arms carry the wheel's weight with road micro-corrections; the woman's hair and scarf lag and whip with the cab's motion.
LIGHTING
Cold overcast daylight, flat and diffuse, exposed for the bright snow field with Alexa-style highlight roll-off so the snow holds detail. Hidden sun glow behind the storm wall backlights the blizzard so the monster face reads as a brighter churning silhouette against the gloom. Truck surfaces catch cool top light with hard cold speculars on wet metal and ice; cab interior falls into cooler shadow, faces revealed by soft windshield bounce and dash glow. Palette stays white, steel-grey, pale cyan — no warm key, no studio fill.
WARDROBE (Mad Max, snow-logical)
Driver: scavenged cold-weather warlord gear — fur-lined battered leather greatcoat over a quilted thermal parka, riveted metal pauldron on one shoulder, fingerless gloves over thermal liners, frost-fogged ski goggles pushed up on a fur-flap ushanka cap, respirator scarf at the neck, bone and scrap-metal ornaments. Weathered, ice-crusted, lived-in.
Woman: hooded fur-collared shearling jacket cinched with leather harness straps and buckles, knitted balaclava pulled down, goggles around the neck, fingerless gloves, scavenged-metal arm guards. Practical, insulated, battle-worn — same scrap-and-fur aesthetic, never impractical for sub-zero cold.
STYLE
Large-scale fantasy-realism in the vein of George Miller's kinetic wasteland chase staging, Denis Villeneuve's monumental scale and cold restraint, Peter Jackson's tactile creature physicality, and Zack Snyder's heroic backlit silhouettes. Photoreal texture, real grain, true film color science, grounded physical cinema — epic scope that still feels captured on a real set.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
IMAX-grade 8K capture, high bitrate 80–120 Mbps, ARRI Alexa large-format sensor character, prime-lens rendering, real-time motion, single continuous take.
POSITIVE LOCKS
Truck present and moving in the very first frame; no empty establishing plate. One continuous push-in from super-wide vista to cab close-up; no cuts. The monster is made of churning snow and ice and stays inside the blizzard wall, never a solid creature on open ground. Driver remains screen-left, woman screen-right inside the cab. Cold white/grey/cyan palette only; faces stay in cool shadow, no warm front fill. Performances stay photoreal and restrained; no stiff or artificial faces.

@Image1 is the lead performer — preserve her exact identity: cornrow braids, septum ring, statement earrings, sculptural white designer top, dark indigo denim. @Audio1 is the finished master track — the only audio; no invented music, no new vocals.

SHE RAPS THE VOCAL ON CAMERA — PRECISE LIPSYNC IS THE TOP PRIORITY. Mouth articulates every syllable of @Audio1 exactly on time. Camera keeps her face visible and sharp during every vocal line; no cutaways mid-word.

LIPSYNC MAP:
0.0–0.5 instrumental — stillness.
0.5–2.8 "I'm standing on the edge / Say it with your chest / Or keep it on the deck" + "Hey!"
3.2–6.7 "I walk in, whole room gets tense / I don't need luck, I'm the consequence / If you really want to test my intent / Come correct, come correct or get bent" + "Woo!"

14.5–15.0 instrumental hold.

Music-video route: performance with crew. Director thesis: she raps at the lens while four background dancers in matte black move as one disciplined organism behind her — she talks, they answer with bodies.

Visual world: raw concrete studio hall, cold window daylight plus one tungsten pool, reflective floor. 4 background dancers (mixed gender) in matte black tanks and cargo trousers, anonymous, faces neutral. Palette: bone white, black, concrete, indigo. No neon, no particles.

Shot flow:
0–3s wide-to-medium push-in: she raps dead center, crew frozen in a diamond formation behind her in shadow; they snap alive on the first "Hey!".
3–7s she struts forward rapping into a backward-dollying camera while the crew lockstep-marches behind her, hitting unison shoulder pops on each snare exactly between her lines.
7.5–10s cut on the kick to low-angle close-up of her second hook — crew silhouettes blurred behind, her articulation front and center.
10–13.7s medium orbital: she raps while the crew executes canon vogue arm waves rippling outward from her on each snare; she points at the lens on "come correct".
13.7–15s final tableau on "Woo!": she freezes one arm high, crew drops to one knee around her, hold. Loopable.

Performance rules: her delivery commanding and stoic, crisp jaw articulation; crew never looks at camera, military precision, never upstages her vocal moments. Continuity: same five people, same wardrobe, same hall. Audio intent: @Audio1 only, mouth locked to its vocal; faint foley. Quality bar: expensive rap performance video, no AI gloss.

title: Scene & Mood: A lone figure prowls a canted concrete over...

Final beat reframes tight and centered on a handheld compact mirror at chest height.

Body leaned diagonally into the tilted wall, one gloved hand braced against rough concrete, chin lifted, gaze angled up and off-frame right through the first six seconds, then dropping to a handheld compact mirror in the final two. Coat, hair, and silhouette remain unchanged and unbroken across the full runtime.

Cross-Frame Rules: The frame contains only the subject throughout; no other figures enter or pass through. Her position along the diagonal axis holds even as the camera angle rotates around her.

Movement: She shifts her weight along the tilted ledge at 0–3s, coat swinging loose with the motion, then braces one hand flat against the concrete and holds at 3–6s while her head tilts back, chin lifting toward the light. At 6–8s she raises a small round compact mirror into frame, tilting it to catch her reflection. Hair lifts and resettles in gusts of wind throughout, coat hem and loose fabric rippling with each shift, breath visible faintly in the cool air. Distant birds cut across the sky in the far background; grit and dust drift low along the concrete ledge.

Last Frame: Tight on the compact mirror held at chest height, her reflected eye and cheekbone sharp in the small round glass, red lips just visible at the mirror's edge, concrete wall soft and dark behind her, sky blown out pale in the negative space beyond her shoulder. No on-screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame.

World Plate: A weathered concrete overpass or parking-structure underpass, tagged with faded spray-paint marks along the base, exposed rebar staining the surface with rust streaks. Overcast midday light, flat and cool, distant tower blocks hazy on the horizon. Dry pavement, light urban dust suspended in the air.

Sound Bed: Leather coat fabric shifting and creaking, boot soles scuffing on rough concrete, a low gust of wind past the microphone, faint distant traffic hum, the soft metallic click of the compact mirror opening.

Capture Realism: Depth built through suspended dust haze between the subject and the distant skyline. Per-zone specular kill on skin keeps highlights soft and matte despite the overcast sky. Contrast curve holds gently lifted blacks, a mid-tone rolloff that never crushes shadow detail, and a soft highlight ceiling that avoids clipping on the pale sky.

Camera Capture: Wide-angle handheld body, 24mm spherical lens, aggressive Dutch-tilt whip movement settling into a held frame, vintage color-negative film rendition with fine 35mm grain, desaturated grunge grade with cool concrete tones and a single warm skin accent, 24fps, framed 16:9, 8 seconds total runtime.

title: Scene & Mood: Surreal nighttime alley editorial with susp...
prompt:
Scene & Mood: Surreal nighttime alley editorial with suspended rain and cold neon stillness. A pale skinned woman with sleek black bob hair stands motionless mid stride in a narrow rain-soaked alley, dressed in a long black vinyl trench coat, silver chain harness over the coat, black leather gloves, and mirrored aviator sunglasses. Around her, raindrops hang frozen in mid air at every distance, catching pink and cyan neon bleed from unreadable signage glow above. The mood is cold, graphic, hypnotic, and cinematic, with suspended time treated as completely real inside a grounded urban alley.

Frame Map: Begin in a full body centered composition, low angle. Subject stands center frame, weight on her back leg, front foot lifted mid step, coat frozen mid swing to one side. Frozen raindrops occupy all depth layers: dense near camera droplets soft blurred in foreground, mid layer droplets sharp around her torso, distant droplets faint near the alley's vanishing point. Wet asphalt fills the lower frame, brick walls and fire escapes frame both sides, a single glowing signage silhouette (shape only, no legible letters) glows at the far end of the alley.

Subject Lock: Subject keeps the same face, hair, wardrobe, body shape, and silhouette throughout. Preserve her black bob, mirrored sunglasses, calm closed-mouth expression, black vinyl trench coat frozen mid-swing, silver chain harness, black gloves, and mid stride frozen pose with front foot lifted. Do not change her hair length, coat color, harness position, glove style, or stride angle. Coat hem and chain links remain fixed in their suspended arc.

Cross Frame Rules: Keep the subject as the only person and main subject. Maintain the same frozen mid stride pose, wardrobe, and suspended raindrop field for all 15 seconds. No new figures enter the alley, no raindrops fall or reset, no duplicated limbs, no body warping, no coat re draping, no sudden pose change. The 360 camera orbit may reveal different sides of the alley, but the subject and raindrop field remain centered, stable, and fully readable. No on screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame.

Movement: 15 seconds total. Subject remains locked mid stride, body held in suspended animation as if time paused around her alone. Micro motion: slow steady breathing visible in coat fabric, faint hair strands drifting almost imperceptibly, sunglasses catching shifting neon reflections as the camera moves, a single strand of chain swaying by a fraction of an inch. Environmental motion: frozen raindrops hold position but shimmer faintly with internal light refraction, distant signage glow pulses slowly, thin steam rises static frozen from a nearby grate, puddle surface holds a rippling reflection loop of the neon glow. Camera motion: one smooth 360 degree orbit around her over the full 15 seconds, gliding through gaps in the frozen raindrop field without disturbing them, circling from front stride view, around her side, past her back, and returning to the starting angle.

Last Frame: At 15 seconds, the camera completes the 360 orbit and settles back near the original centered low angle composition. Subject remains frozen mid stride, coat suspended mid swing, sunglasses reflecting soft neon glow, raindrops still hanging motionless around her at every depth. Camera eases to a steady centered frame with no visible shake. No on screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame.

World Plate: Narrow urban alley at night, wet black asphalt, aged brick walls, iron fire escapes, a single distant glowing sign shape with unreadable light bleed, thin static steam from a street grate, deep atmospheric haze softening the far end of the alley. Cold neon pink and cyan light mix with practical amber window glow from upper floors. The environment stays grounded and physically real, making the suspended rain feel clean, deliberate, and photographed rather than digitally generated.

Sound Bed: Diegetic audio only: distant city hum, faint dripping from unfrozen gutter runoff, soft creak of a fire escape in wind, low electrical buzz from the neon sign, subtle fabric tension in the frozen coat, faint distant traffic murmur. No music, no soundtrack, no score, no lyrics.

Capture Realism: Natural skin texture, matte skin under gloves, realistic vinyl coat sheen, believable chain metal weight, grounded wet asphalt reflections, soft neon highlight rolloff, lifted shadows in the brick shadows, mild 35mm grain, realistic frozen droplet light refraction, clean night exposure with controlled highlight bloom. Avoid AI gloss, plastic skin, over sharp puddle reflections, warped hands, melted chain links, duplicated body parts, crushed blacks, clipped highlights, and fake motion blur on the frozen rain.

Camera Capture: 15 seconds, 24fps, 180 degree shutter, wide latitude cinema capture, smooth stabilized 360 degree orbit with subtle handheld breath, 35mm lens for full body environmental fashion framing, fine 35mm grain, soft highlight rolloff, cool neon and amber night color grade, realistic motion blur, stable subject tracking, and practical editorial realism.

title: CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed ...
prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from morning desk light. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy desk-care vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: watering can pour, leaf wiping, paper stacking, pen cup shifting, soft desk taps.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain hoodie, glasses, tousled hair, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy while resetting his workspace.
SETTING: Small home office corner on a weekday morning. Soft daylight, small potted plants on the desk, scattered papers, quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (2s, propped medium shot) Places camera on a shelf, sits at the desk. "Quick desk reset before work."
→ (2s, overhead shot) Waters each small plant carefully. Only pouring sounds.
→ (2s, close-up) Wipes dust off plant leaves with a soft cloth.
→ (2s, handheld shot) Rotates a pot toward the light. "You need more sun, don't you."
→ (2s, detail shot) Stacks loose papers into a neat pile. No dialogue.
→ (2s, medium shot) Sorts pens into a cup, tidies cables. "Okay, much less chaotic now."
→ (2s, macro shot) Wipes down the desk surface with a cloth.
→ (2s, propped shot) Adjusts a small desk lamp angle.
→ (2s, warm ending shot) Looks at the tidy desk, satisfied smile. "Ready to actually get some work done."
→ (1.5s, final shot) Reaches toward camera. "Catch you later." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience watering, leaf wiping, paper stacking should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine small smiles, occasional pauses, imperfect framing, focus breathing, soft morning light shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal desk vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial production.

衣装は参照画像の世界観を保ちながら、実写MV向けに華やかに再設計する。地味な私服は禁止。普通のシャツ、普通のパンツ、無難なジャケット、暗すぎる服装は禁止。参照画像の雰囲気を壊さず、ステージ映えするファッションへ拡張する。

衣装には光沢素材、レイヤード、短めジャケット、揺れる布、チェーン、ベルト、リボン、アクセサリー、ブーツ、手袋、メタリックパーツ、透け感、差し色を加える。動いた時に髪、布、リボン、アクセサリーが美しく揺れる。女性参照の場合は、可愛さ、色気、強さ、ステージ映えを両立する。男性参照の場合も、キレ、華やかさ、強いシルエットを出す。

手書きアニメーション風エフェクトを追加する。人物の動きに合わせて、白線、黒インク線、ラフなブラシライン、手描きスピード線、丸印、バツ印、波線、星形、稲妻、擦れた筆跡、手描き残像が一瞬だけ出る。実写映像に2D手描きアニメを合成した質感。線は少し揺れ、コマ落ち感のあるラフな動きにする。

VFXは身体の動きに反応する。足の接地で粒子と手描き円形波紋。かかとのひねりで粒子軌跡と白線。肩ヒットで背景線が震え、衝撃線。手首スナップでインク斬撃と白いブラシ斬撃。指フリックで小さなスパークと星形。ターンで回転線と短い残像。VFXは顔、身体、脚のライン、衣装ディテールを隠さない。

ダンスはMVで見栄えする魅力的なストリートダンス。細かい足踏みだけにしない。脚だけで踊らず、上品、腰、腕、首、視線まで使って魅せる。腕のライン、肩の抜き、腰の小さな揺れ、髪の動き、ターン、手首スナップ、指先、カメラ目線、表情変化を入れる。女性にも似合うしなやかさ、男性にも似合うキレを両立する。

低重心は禁止。膝は曲げ続けず、アクセントで一瞬だけ使い、すぐ伸ばす。高めの重心、綺麗な立ち姿、流れる連続動作を優先する。棒立ち、歩くだけ、地味な横揺れ、単調な足踏みは禁止。動きに華やかさ、余裕、色気、可愛さ、強さ、キャラクター性を出す。

0.0s - 1.0s開始直後からすでに踊っている。中距離の全身ワンカット。片足を前へ踏み込み、膝を一瞬だけ使ってすぐ伸ばす。肩ヒット、手首スナップ、ヒールトゥ、つま先タップ、クロスステップへ繋ぐ。顔は参照画像の雰囲気を保ち、短くカメラを見る。背景グラフィティが跳ね、足元から粒子波紋と手描き円形波紋が広がる。

1.0s - 2.2sカットを切らず、カメラが軽く押し込む。身体を斜め向きへ切り替え、前後ステップでグルーヴを作る。片手を髪や衣装ディテールへ流し、もう片手を下へフリック。左肩ヒット、右肩ヒット、胸ヒット、首スナップ。髪と衣装が少し遅れて揺れる。背景の線が震え、白いブラシ線が一瞬走る。

2.2s - 3.4sカメラを切らずに少し下げ、全身の中に足元も含める。つま先タップ2回、かかとを引く。片膝を一瞬だけ使い、すぐ伸ばす。カメラは自然に全身へ戻り、鋭いクロスステップで斜め前へ出る。腰を小さく回し、目線を一瞬カメラへ戻す。手首からリング状VFXと手描き円線が広がり、粒子に砕ける。

3.4s - 4.6sコンパクトなランニングマン変形。後ろへ軽く引き、前へ戻す。腕を身体の近くから外へ短く開き、衣装と髪を揺らす。身体を斜めにピボットし、小さくターン。指フリックでスパークと星形。背景の巨大グラフィティが波打ち、抽象記号がターンに合わせて渦を作る。

4.6s - 5.8sワンカットのまま小さく半円回り込み。片足クロス、反対足オープン、胸ヒット。片肩を抜き、腰を小さく流して余裕と色気を出す。手首スナップ、反対の手首スナップ、指フリック。手を髪、首元、衣装ディテールへ流してすぐ離す。白いブラシ線、ドット軌跡、手描きスパークが手先に反応する。

5.8s - 7.0s細かく体重を乗せ替え、肩を少し遅らせる。腰は小さく品よく揺れる。斜めシャッフル、ヒールトゥ、つま先スクレイプ。足元に手描きスピード線。腕を一度だけ大きめに流し、布、髪、アクセサリーの揺れを見せる。背景レイヤーが上下し、グラフィティの一部が剥がれて粒子になる。

7.0s - 8.4sカットを切らず少し寄る。短い視線と表情を入れる。片手で衣装ディテールを少し引き、すぐ離す。もう片手は顔の横から外へ流す。タイトな半回転で正面へ戻る。ターンで髪と衣装が綺麗に遅れて揺れる。肩ヒット、手首スナップ、胸ヒット、指フリック。背景記号が一度脈打ち、稲妻と丸印が短く出る。

8.4s - 9.8sカメラは自然に全身へ戻る。反対方向へ身体の向きを切り替え、前後ステップでグルーヴを作る。片肘を外へ切り、片手を腰や衣装ディテールへ流す。胴体を一度ひねる。片膝を一瞬だけ使い、すぐ伸ばす。靴から粒子波紋とラフな円形波紋。反射床に衣装カラーの光が走る。

9.8s - 11.2s背景がさらに活発化。グラフィティ、記号、粒子、光線、スプレー跡がレイヤー状に跳ねる。人物は前景で明確に分離する。クロスステップ、オープンステップ、手首スナップ、指フリック、首スナップ。腰を小さく抜き、肩を遅れて戻す。インク斬撃、スパーク、白線、星形が別々に反応する。

11.2s - 12.6sカメラがワンカットで少し回り込む。かかとを軽く引く。肩を落とす。胸ヒット。手首を解放。衣装、アクセサリー、髪の揺れを見せる。カメラを見たまま斜め後ろへステップ。片手は衣装付近、もう片手で下へフリック。波形VFXと手描き波線が広がり、背景へ溶ける。

12.6s - 14.1sつま先タップ、軽い膝アクセント、肩ヒット、身体のリコイル。膝は一瞬だけ使い、すぐ伸ばす。腕を身体の近くから外へ流し、指先まで綺麗に見せる。前後ステップ、片足クロス、身体を少し回す。腰と髪の動きで次へ繋ぐ。背景グラフィティが波のように動き、スプレー粒子が背後に散る。

14.1s - 15.0s前後ステップとクロスステップを継続。軽いターンへ入り、髪、衣装、アクセサリーが大きく綺麗に揺れる。背景のグラフィティ、手描き記号、光線、粒子が背後で広がる。靴から粒子の尾とラフな白線が引く。身体が回り続け、カメラもワンカットのまま軽く押し込む途中で終わる。

全体印象：参照画像ベースの派手なグラフィティ系実写MVダンス。背景は風景ではなく、動くアートステージ。衣装は地味にせず、華やかなMV衣装へ拡張。ダンスは魅力、余裕、色気、可愛さ、強さを見せる。人物の顔、髪型、体型、表情、シルエット最優先。

テキストオーバーレイなし。字幕なし。ロゴなし。読める長文なし。普通の風景背景なし。地味な衣装なし。棒立ちなし。歩くだけなし。

Use the attached VIKING VS KRAKEN character sheet as visual reference throughout. Create a 15-second 16:9 Pixar 3D animated battle sequence. Bjorn — broad shoulders, braided red beard, fur-lined leather armor, iron pauldrons, battle-worn longsword, war paint streaked across one eye. The Kraken — colossal sea monster, deep crimson and black mottled skin, massive curling tentacles, enormous glowing yellow eyes. Same characters exactly as shown in the reference sheet throughout every shot.
THE SHIP: A Viking longship at sea, wooden hull, carved dragon prow, single mast with a tattered sail. Stormy night sky, dark churning ocean, rain falling, occasional lightning flashes illuminating everything. One location only — the ship and the surrounding sea.
Shot sequence:
0:00–0:02 — Wide establishing shot. The longship rocking violently on dark stormy waves, rain pouring, lightning flashing in the distance. Bjorn stands at the bow gripping the railing, scanning the black water. Complete tension. Something is coming.
0:02–0:04 — Close-up on the water beside the ship. A single massive tentacle breaks the surface slowly, water cascading off its crimson and black skin, curling menacingly upward. Bjorn's eyes widen as he spots it.
0:04–0:06 — Wide shot. The Kraken's full head and one enormous glowing yellow eye breach the surface beside the ship — water exploding outward in every direction. The ship rocks violently from the displacement. Bjorn draws his sword, bracing low.
0:06–0:08 — Dramatic close-up. A second tentacle whips up and wraps around the ship's mast — wood splintering and cracking under the pressure. Bjorn slashes at it with his sword, sparks of impact visible where blade meets tentacle.
0:08–0:11 — SLOW MOTION. Bjorn leaps onto the railing, sword raised high above his head, lightning flashing behind him illuminating his entire silhouette. 0:11–0:13 — Normal speed snaps back instantly. The sword connects — the tentacle recoils and releases the mast, retreating back into the dark water. The Kraken's massive eye narrows, assessing the Viking who just struck back.
0:13–0:15 — Wide shot. Bjorn stands alone at the bow, breathing hard, sword still raised, rain streaming down his face. The Kraken's eye sinks slowly back beneath the black water, retreating into the depths. The storm beginning to calm. Bjorn lowers his sword slowly, victorious but exhausted. Fade out on the ship sailing on through the calming sea.
Camera: Wide establishing for the storm and ship, close-up for the tentacle reveal, wide for the Kraken's full breach, dramatic close-up for the mast attack, slow motion wide tracking for the sword strike hero shot, normal speed snap back for the impact, wide static pulling back for the final victorious pose. Sound: Crashing waves and pouring rain throughout. Thunder rumbling. Tense orchestral music building from the first frame. The Kraken's breach — a deep guttural roar. Wood splintering as the tentacle grips the mast. The sword strike — one sharp metallic ring. Music peaks during the slow motion strike. The Kraken's retreat — a low fading groan beneath the water. Music resolves to a triumphant but weary tone as the storm calms. Fade out on rain softening to a gentle patter.
Style: Pixar 3D animation. Dark stormy blues and blacks throughout, lightning providing dramatic flashes of light. Bjorn in cold steel and weathered brown. Kraken in deep crimson, black and bioluminescent yellow eyes glowing through the darkness. Maximum scale contrast between the tiny Viking and the colossal beast. This is an epic clash — every frame should feel massive and earned

title: 高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの流れるような戦闘シーンが描かれます...
prompt:
高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの流れるような戦闘シーンが描かれます。00:00–00:00（冒頭フレーム：手元アップ）
00:00–00:03（法陣生成・地脈覚醒）
カメラ：指に輝く黄金の指輪の極アップから急速に引き → 俯瞰ショット
アクション：瘦せた老人が両手で複雑な印を結び、ゆっくりと床に押し当てる。指先が微かに震え、黄金の指輪・腕輪・首輪・足輪が共鳴するように光る。
エフェクト：老人を中心に真紅と純白の二色が爆発的に広がり、巨大な円形の召喚陣が展開。強烈な赤白のルーンが星河のように回転し、黒いゴシック聖堂の床に深いひび割れを生む。瓦礫やステンドグラスの破片が浮遊し、赤白の光に包まれる。
雰囲気：威圧的で神聖かつ邪悪、古の力が目覚める荘厳さ。00:03–00:06（式神顕性・魔熊降臨）
カメラ：召喚陣中心のアップ → クイック周回フォロー
アクション：老人は胸の前で両手を素早く組み替え、強力な召喚印を完成させる（指を激しく絡め、親指を外側に回し、黄金の指輪同士を打ち鳴らすような動き）。体はわずかに前傾し、黄色い瞳が激しく輝く。
エフェクト：召喚陣から真紅＋純白の濃密な霊気が噴き上がり、巨大な傷だらけの魔熊パンダの影がゆっくりと実体化。体中を覆う古い鎖がガチャガチャと鳴り、深い傷跡から赤白の霊力が滲み出る。目が凶悪に輝き、牙を剥く。
日本語呪文（低く枯れた、しかし圧倒的な老人の声）
『我が血と鎖よ、目覚めよ……魔熊よ、我に従え！』
雰囲気：圧倒的な存在感、契約の強制。00:06–00:09（憑依融合・変身開始）
カメラ：老人の上半身アップ → 顔へ急速接近
アクション：印を結んだ両手を勢いよく胸に押し当てる。魔熊の巨大な影が老人の背中と肩から体内へ溶け込む。老人の瘦せた体が一瞬大きく反り、黄金の装飾品が激しく光り輝く。
エフェクト：真紅＋純白の奔流が四肢を駆け巡る。黒いローブの上に赤白の魔術紋様が浮かび上がり、鎖の模様が浮遊。白髪は逆立ち、黄色い瞳がより鋭く獰猛になる。
ディテール：顔に赤白の霊力の筋が走り、目じりに魔熊の傷痕のような呪紋が刻まれる。
雰囲気：魂の融合、古の魔導士と魔獣の合一。00:09–00:12（最終変身・武器顕現・戦闘体完成）
カメラ：見上げる全身ショット → 横からのスローモーション
アクション：両手が勢いよく開き、霊力の中から巨大な**鎖付きの爪型武器（獣爪ガントレット）**が形成される。老人は体を低く構え、片膝を深く落とし、もう片方の脚を後ろに引き、野獣のような戦闘姿勢を取る。黄金の指輪と鎖が激しく鳴る。
エフェクト：武器は真紅と純白の光を放ち、刃部分に魔熊の傷跡と古代ルーンが刻まれる。背中に魔熊の巨大な残像が浮かび、赤白の霊力のマントのように揺れる。
スタイリング：黒を基調としたボロボロのゴシック魔導ローブに赤白の紋様が浮かぶ。瘦せた体から溢れる圧倒的な魔力。動作は老齢を感じさせず、獰猛で重厚。
雰囲気：完全覚醒、破壊の準備完了。00:12–00:15（準備完了・初戦予行）
カメラ：360°周回アップ → 爪を正面で固定撮影（GoPro風）
アクション：老人は爪を軽く振り、赤白の光弧を大きく描く。低く構えた姿勢で地面を爪で掻き、魔熊の威嚇のような咆哮を小さく漏らす。
エフェクト：光弧が赤白の残像を残し、全身から溢れる霊力が聖堂全体を震わせる。
雰囲気：静寂と爆発の狭間、圧倒的な戦闘準備。要求：60フレーム、四周年OADにふさわしい完璧な品質、作画崩壊レベルの流れるようなアニメーション、劇的なライティングと重厚な影の演出

Single-take 15s:
A dust-covered man stands alone in a wasteland. Handheld camera circles him in a 360° orbit with slight shake from heat. He slowly raises his hand—fingertips turn semi-transparent, air distorts.
His body convulses under pressure. Glowing golden cracks spread beneath his skin, bones crack. Purple-black smoke with blue electrical arcs bursts from his spine. Deep fractures leak liquid gold.
Floating metal debris is pulled toward him. Rusted black armor plates slam into his body with sparks, forming uneven armor—cracked shoulders and a chest plate revealing a molten core.
Red metal spreads across his face, forming a mask. His eyes collapse, then ignite with blue electric light, one flickering. Two large black horns emerge with faint purple flames.
Final: he raises his hand, forming a blue flame like a miniature black hole. He slams the ground—spiraling gravity shockwave destroys nearby ruins. Silence. Broken black wings extend. He lifts his head, blue eyes glowing through the fog.

title: In a telekinetic action scene, a South Korean high school...
prompt: In a telekinetic action scene, a South Korean high school girl in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt stands calmly in the middle of a corridor. She is being attacked from both sides; some attackers, wearing brown school uniform jackets, wield short sticks, while others are dressed as black ninjas, creating a tense standoff in the corridor. As the enemies rush towards her, the girl unleashes a powerful telekinetic attack. Suddenly, everything around her enters a state of weightlessness and time freezes. Dozens of items—open textbooks, notebooks, a red soda can, and a wooden school chair—leave the ground, perfectly suspending themselves in mid-air. The attackers, in their lunging movements, are frozen in mid-air by an invisible force. Paper pages, scraps of paper, and dust float and swirl around her weightlessly. The camera slowly zooms in on the girl, perfectly freezing the chaotic corridor in the telekinetic-induced state of stillness and suspension. In the extreme stillness of the slowly zooming-in, frozen image, the girl's calm eyes narrow slightly. Immediately afterward, she calmly raised her right hand, her fingers loosely clenched, and then made a light yet decisive flick of her sleeve to either side of her body. In an instant, frozen time and gravity seemed to explode with this subtle gesture. A low rumble echoed in the air, and dozens of objects that had been suspended in mid-air—a heavy wooden school chair, scattered textbooks, even the red soda can—transformed into a dense projection, carrying powerful air currents, and were precisely launched towards the enemies attacking from both sides. At the same time, an invisible circular psychic shockwave violently spread out from the girl. The brown-uniformed attackers and black-clad ninjas, who had been frozen in mid-air, were instantly struck by this immense force, their bodies jolted violently, and they were sent flying backward like kites with broken strings to either end of the corridor. As gravity instantly returned, the wooden chairs shattered upon impact, textbooks scattered into a flurry of pages, and with the dull thud of heavy objects hitting the ground, the attackers collapsed onto the corridor floor, incapacitated. Silence returned to the corridor, broken only by countless tattered papers and fine dust drifting slowly in the air. The aftershocks of the shockwave ruffled the girl's bangs and hair. She remained composed, not even glancing at her fallen opponent. The girl slowly lowered her right hand, raised her slender left, and gracefully and calmly tucked a strand of black hair behind her ear, revealing her delicate and serene profile. The camera froze on this moment, the white papers falling around her like snowflakes, highlighting her still figure in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt. Then, the image faded out.

title: 高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの流れるような戦闘シーンが描かれます。
prompt:
高品質な日式アニメ（Anime）調の動画で、「作画崩壊（Sakuga）」レベルの流れるような戦闘シーンが描かれます。

00:00–00:00（冒頭フレーム：印を結ぶ手元アップ）

00:00–00:03（法陣生成・地脈覚醒）
カメラ：掌の金の光のアップから急速に引き → 俯瞰ショット
アクション：両手で印を結び、そっと下へ押し当てる。指先が法陣の文様に合わせて微かに震え、大地を撫でるような姿勢で、霊力が掌から地面に染み込んでいく
エフェクト：少女を中心に、金色の平安時代の呪紋の法陣が素早く展開。符文が星河のように流れ、地面のひび割れから金の光が滲み出る。周囲の瓦礫が浮遊回転する。
雰囲気：神聖で威圧的、地脈が応答する

00:03–00:06（式神顕性・オオサンショウウオの霊体降臨）
カメラ：法陣中心のアップ → クイック周回フォロー
アクション：少女は胸の前で両手を素早く組み、印を結びかえる（陰陽師「大鯢召喚印」：両手を重ね、指を絡め、親指を外側に回して環状にする）。その動きは舞のように滑らかで、体は印のリズムに合わせてほんの少し前に傾く
エフェクト：法陣中心から墨緑＋金紫の二色の霊力の霞が立ち上る。巨大な日本オオサンショウウオ（大山椒魚）の式神の影がゆっくりと現れる：丸みを帯びた頭部、皺だらけの皮膚、長い尾が揺れ動く。霊力の霞の中に金色の鱗の紋様と水紋の呪印が浮かび上がり、少女の印を結ぶ動作と呼応する。
日本語呪文（清冷で威厳のある声）
『山椒の霊、我に従え！力を授けよ！』
雰囲気：霊体の具象化、契約の締結

00:06–00:09（憑依融合・変身開始）
カメラ：少女の上半身アップ → 顔へ急速接近
アクション：印を結んだ両手を勢いよく胸に押し当てる。オオサンショウウオの影が頭頂と背中から体内に溶け込む。少女の体は少し後ろに反り、霊力が流れ込むのを感じながら、印を結んだ姿勢を融合完了まで保つ。
エフェクト：金紫＋墨緑の流れる光が四肢を這う。制服の上に巫女の紋様が浮かび上がり、スカートの裾は軽やかな動きやすい戦闘スカートへと変わる。髪は引き締まったツインテールに束ねられ、全身に水紋状の霊力の障壁が形成される。
ディテール：顔に霊力の輝きが走り、目の表情は沈静から鋭さへ変わる。目じりにオオサンショウウオの霊紋が浮かぶ。
雰囲気：魂と魂の融合、力の覚醒

00:09–00:12（最終変身・短刀顕現・敏捷体完成）
カメラ：見上げる全身ショット → 横からのスローモーション静止画
アクション：印を結んでいた両手が突然に分かれる。短剣（ダガー）が霊力の中から形を成し、抜き放たれる。少女は体を横向きにし、旋回するように片脚で地面を踏み、もう一方の脚を後ろへ軽く上げる。手首を返し、刃を握る構えを取り、姿勢は猫のように軽やか。
エフェクト：短剣は金紫＋墨緑の流れる光を放ち、刀身にはオオサンショウウオの鱗紋と巫女の符文が刻まれている。衣の端は風に激しくなびき、背後にはオオサンショウウオの影が敏捷な戦闘霊紋となって付着する（背中の鱗の紋様、手首の水紋など）。
スタイリング：ボディラインにフィットした巫女戦闘服。腰帯に短剣を挿している。動作は軽やかで鋭く、巫女の神聖さと暗殺者の敏捷さを兼ね備える。
雰囲気：変身完了、全戦闘力解放

00:12–00:15（準備完了・初戦予行）
カメラ：360°周回アップ → 短剣を正面で固定撮影（GoPro風）
アクション：少女は手首を軽くしならせ、短剣で鋭い水紋の光弧を描く。爪先で地面を軽く蹴り、狩猟の準備体勢を取る（重心を低くし、膝を少し曲げ、オオサンショウウオの待ち伏せ姿勢のように）。
エフェクト：短剣の光弧が金緑色の水紋の残像を残す。全身の霊力は安定し始め、法陣の微かな光は消えていく。
雰囲気：時を待ち、爆発寸前の静けさ。

要求：60フレーム、四周年OADにふさわしい完璧な品質

title: 65mm IMAX, ultra-wide anamorphic lens, heavy film grain, ...
prompt:

A dust-covered man stands alone in a wasteland. Handheld camera circles him in a 360° orbit with slight shake from heat. He slowly raises his hand—fingertips turn semi-transparent, air distorts.
His body convulses under pressure. Glowing golden cracks spread beneath his skin, bones crack. Purple-black smoke with blue electrical arcs bursts from his spine. Deep fractures leak liquid gold.
Floating metal debris is pulled toward him. Rusted black armor plates slam into his body with sparks, forming uneven armor—cracked shoulders and a chest plate revealing a molten core.
Red metal spreads across his face, forming a mask. His eyes collapse, then ignite with blue electric light, one flickering. Two large black horns emerge with faint purple flames.
Final: he raises his hand, forming a blue flame like a miniature black hole. He slams the ground—spiraling gravity shockwave destroys nearby ruins. Silence. Broken black wings extend. He lifts his head, blue eyes glowing through the fog.
